misconceptions.description: Writing narration that reads the on-screen text word for word
misconceptions.trigger: learner records audio that repeats the bullet points verbatim
misconceptions.feedback: Narration should add what the slide cannot show: the reason, the example, the so-what. Do not read the bullets.

misconceptions.description: Using an AI-generated voice without disclosing it or checking its accuracy
misconceptions.trigger: learner uses a synthetic voice that mispronounces a key term and adds no note that it is AI
misconceptions.feedback: Disclose AI narration where required and proofrerad the audio for wrong pronunciations and inserted errors.

misconceptions.description: Treating an AI-drafted narration script as a finished script
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes the model output as the final voiceover with no edits
misconceptions.feedback: Treat the AI script as a first draft: cut filler, fix claims, and match it to your slide timing.
